title: 🎂 THE LAST BIRTHDAY II: THE THINGS WE BURIED
author: Due-Nature9853
selftext:
🎂 THE NIGHTMARE ISN'T OVER.

Something was buried beneath Candlewick's Celebration Palace.

The missing children. The forgotten recordings. The secrets of Port Halloway.

And Mr. Morrow remembers everything.

🩸 THE LAST BIRTHDAY II: THE THINGS WE BURIED

An upcoming psychological survival horror game by DeadLetterStudios.

📅 Coming November 20, 2026.

Some birthdays should never be remembered.
